question: How many S. marcescens strains does the ATCC hold, and how are they split between biosafety levels?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%ATCC%' OR text ILIKE '%biosafety%' OR text ILIKE '%BSL%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=12 AND line_no BETWEEN 8 AND 22 ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=12 AND line_no BETWEEN 22 AND 30 ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%BSL%' OR text ILIKE '%Level 3%' OR text ILIKE '%Level 2%' OR text ILIKE '%Level 1%'  ORDER BY page, id
